_comment: Example whitelist. Copy to whitelist.json and fill in. All 8 keys must be present (lists of strings). Matching is case-insensitive; '/' and '\' are equivalent; trailing backslashes are ignored. Detection-text prefixes ('TASK: ', 'DRIVER CERT: ', ...) and ' [RUNNING]'/' [STOPPED]' suffixes are stripped before matching, so whitelist the bare path or name.
